title: Infant passenger
why: Checks that a Baby with Age 0 and a short name is accepted and stored. Age 0 is a boundary that falsy-value checks often treat as missing.

steps.does: Fetch the passenger passport P1234567 by its Id, then list passengers filtered to type Baby.

expect: The passenger is returned with PassengerType Baby and Age 0 (the zero is kept, not null or dropped). The Baby filter includes this record.
